messages:
Tanya: Quick RFC follow-up — thinking about moving *soft* quota enforcement to edge proxies as a first line of defense. Edge keeps a small local credit pool and returns a 429-with-warn header when exhausted. Central reconciler enforces hard quota and rebalances periodically. Tradeoffs: lower tail latency vs eventual consistency. Thoughts?

Omar: Edge enforcement would cut tail latency for bursty tenants, +1. Main worry is long-lived overdraft: if edges hand out provisional grants and central later says no, we end up with inconsistent chargebacks. How do we bound overdraft?

Jin: Idea: provisional lease tokens with short TTL (e.g., 1s). Edge grants provisional token for request weight, commits deltas to central in batches. Central can revoke/deny on reconciliation but leases expire quickly so overdraft window is bounded.

Riley: Observability needs: per-edge gauge provisional_balance, counters for provisional_issued vs central_committed, and sampled rejected traces (tenant, model, seq_len). Correlate with latency and cost estimates.

Omar: Abuse vector: attackers open many short-lived connections against different edges to drain all local pools. Need per-client fingerprinting + rapid backoff. Also limit number of provisional leases per client per edge.

Tanya: Proposed policy parameters: local_quota_window=5s, soft_ratio=0.6 (edge grants up to 60% of expected steady quota), hard_query_threshold=0.1 (edge asks central when balance <10% or request_weight > Y). Edge returns a header X-Quota-Warn:soft or X-Quota-Action:central-query. Config should be dynamic via feature flags.

Jin: Implementation note: edges should write monotonic delta entries to a central append-only buffer for idempotent reconciliation (per-edge seq numbers). Central reconciler consumes deltas, updates global counters, and emits corrective events if mismatches exceed threshold. Keep entries small to minimize bandwidth.

Riley: Rollout plan: feature-flagged, start on internal tenants + alpha customers. Canary in us-west only. Telemetry: mismatch_rate = (edge_granted - central_committed) / max(1, edge_granted). Alert if mismatch_rate > 0.05 for 1m. Track 95p latency and central QPS.

ops-bot: deploy-checklist: set ff edge_softquota=true -> route 5% traffic -> monitor mismatch_rate, 95p latency, central QPS. If mismatch_rate rises OR central QPS spikes, rollback ff. @Tanya assign @Jin for central reconciler and @Omar for edge proxy change.

Tanya: I'll drive rollout coordination. Jin/Omar sync tomorrow 10:00am PT. Also add manual kill-switch in proxy admin.

Jin: Will prototype lease format: `{edge_id, tenant_id, seq, weight, ttl_ms}` and a batched commit endpoint `/quota/commit` that accepts delta lists. Add admin toggle `allow_edge_enforce`.

Omar: I'll add client fingerprinting (IP + conn-hash + short-lived session id) and a short blackhole policy for high-frequency offenders. Emit events to /alerts/quota-abuse.

Riley: Also ensure edge cost-estimator uses projected tokens (model + prompt length) rather than simple request count so we don't undercharge long-seq requests.

Tanya: Summarizing action items: (1) prototype token lease + short TTL (Jin), (2) edge proxy config + fingerprint/backoff (Omar), (3) telemetry dashboards + alerts + mismatch metrics (Riley). Plan: canary next week. :thumbsup:
